title: The Sun as a scalar wave generator sending information

plain: Michels wonders aloud whether the Sun might be a scalar wave generator, scalar waves being a proposed kind of energy wave outside standard physics, and whether we might be getting information from it. He offers this as his own speculation while talking with the philosopher James Madden about consciousness and Plato's cave, and he links it to ideas that he says people high in government seem to back. If true, the Sun would be a source of information, not only of light and heat.
